findings.evidenceJa: それと。
findings.governingReading: And another thing.
findings.explanation: A firm transition to Shirou’s tactical confirmation becomes a hesitant filler.

findings.highlight: keeping Kuzuki-sensei away as long as possible
findings.evidenceJa: 葛木先生をできるだけ引き離してくれればいい
findings.governingReading: draw Kuzuki-sensei as far away as you can
findings.explanation: Rin’s spatial instruction to separate Kuzuki from Caster becomes a duration instruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 礼拝堂をつっきって
findings.governingReading: cut straight through the chapel
findings.explanation: The specific church interior traversed by Rin and Shirou becomes a generic main area.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to dodge his attacks
findings.evidenceJa: 初撃さえ躱せまい。
findings.governingReading: I would not be able to evade even his opening blow
findings.explanation: The immediate danger of failing against Kuzuki’s very first strike becomes generic inability against plural attacks.

findings.highlight: I think Tohsaka hung her head
findings.evidenceJa: 辛そうに俯いた気がした。
findings.governingReading: It seemed to him that Rin lowered her head painfully.
findings.explanation: The tentative observation remains, but the visible pain that prompts it disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂へ飛び降りた。
findings.governingReading: jump down into the sanctuary
findings.explanation: The church sanctuary is inconsistently recast as a temple.

findings.highlight: This was supposed to be a surprise attack
findings.evidenceJa: 奇襲に近い乱入だというのに
findings.governingReading: although their sudden intrusion amounted almost to a surprise attack
findings.explanation: A description of the entry’s effect becomes an intended plan that supposedly failed.

findings.evidenceJa: 透明な殺意
findings.governingReading: his transparent or imperceptible killing intent
findings.explanation: “Clear” makes Kuzuki’s murderous intent obvious, contradicting the preceding statement that Shirou can feel none of it.

findings.evidenceJa: 葛木宗一郎という人物の恐ろしさ
findings.governingReading: the terror inherent in the person called Kuzuki Souichirou
findings.explanation: The deliberate formulation of Kuzuki’s personhood as frightening becomes childish generic “scariness.”

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは磔にされたまま
findings.governingReading: Saber remains crucified
findings.explanation: The exact restraint and sacrificial image of Saber’s crucifixion disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 全身で息をするように小さく震えていた。
findings.governingReading: She had trembled faintly as though breathing with her entire body.
findings.explanation: The full-body breathing simile becomes literal gasping and loses the restrained scale of the tremor.

findings.evidenceJa: 凍り付いたように静かだった。
findings.governingReading: she is now still as though frozen solid
findings.explanation: An image of ominous physical immobility becomes a colloquial phrase that suggests only silence and carries an unsupported death overtone.

findings.evidenceJa: イヤな予感に軋む。
findings.governingReading: His body or nerves creak under the terrible premonition.
findings.explanation: The bodily grinding response to Shirou’s premonition disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: どこの田舎者よって感じでさ
findings.governingReading: you look like some country bumpkin
findings.explanation: Rin’s fashion insult is strengthened into a gendered, age-marked slur absent from her wording.

findings.highlight: insults Caster, hoping to break her composure
findings.evidenceJa: 余裕げなキャスターに負けじと憎まれ口を叩く
findings.governingReading: hurls abuse so as not to be outdone by Caster’s apparent composure
findings.explanation: Rin’s competitive performance of equal composure becomes an attempt to break Caster’s.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is facing Caster by going counterclockwise, so I walk clockwise.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が左回りにキャスターを追い詰めるなら、俺は右回りに距離をつめる。
findings.governingReading: As Rin presses Caster while circling left, Shirou closes in while circling right.
findings.explanation: Active pressure and converging distance become vague facing and walking, obscuring the pincer movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 疎ましげに遠坂だけを睨んでいた。
findings.governingReading: Caster glares only at Rin with open annoyance and aversion.
findings.explanation: The exclusive target and Caster’s disgusted manner disappear.

findings.highlight: to a place where I can attack Caster from behind.
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターを挟み撃ちできる位置まで移動する。
findings.governingReading: moves into a position from which he and Rin can catch Caster in a pincer
findings.explanation: A two-sided pincer is changed into Shirou positioning himself directly behind Caster.

findings.highlight: He is acting of his own free will.
findings.evidenceJa: あいつは自分の意志でキャスターのマスターになっている。
findings.governingReading: He became and remains Caster’s Master by his own will.
findings.explanation: The English preserves generic free action but omits that Kuzuki voluntarily assumed the Master role itself.

findings.highlight: Caster seeks the Holy Grail frantically
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を執拗に求めるキャスター
findings.governingReading: Caster pursues the Holy Grail with relentless persistence
findings.explanation: Caster’s sustained obsession becomes frantic manner.

findings.highlight: the Master protects her without question
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の意志などなくキャスターを守るマスター
findings.governingReading: the Master protects Caster without asserting any will of his own
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s absence of an independent objective becomes unquestioning obedience, despite the immediately preceding denial of magical control.

findings.evidenceJa: それで、意味もなく思ってしまった。
findings.governingReading: For no particular reason, that thought occurs to him.
findings.explanation: A deliberately ungrounded counterfactual is presented as a conclusion caused by the role reversal.

findings.highlight: This is the third time I’ve fought you.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴女との小競り合いもこれで三度目。
findings.governingReading: This makes the third skirmish between us.
findings.explanation: Rin’s dismissive minimization of their earlier clashes becomes three full fights.

findings.evidenceJa: まずその性根を直してらっしゃいな
findings.governingReading: first go correct that disposition of yours
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s classic branch changes Caster’s attack on Rin’s underlying disposition into an insult to her intelligence.

findings.highlight: I need to discipline that arrogant mouth of yours
findings.evidenceJa: その増長、厳しく躾る必要がある
findings.governingReading: I must severely discipline that overweening conceit
findings.explanation: Caster targets Rin’s swelling arrogance, not the way her mouth speaks.

findings.evidenceJa: 葛木の一撃に阻まれる。
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki’s single blow intercepts and stops him.
findings.explanation: The precise one-strike interception that opens the matchup becomes generic obstruction by Kuzuki.

findings.highlight: I would be killed in an instant if I fought Caster.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺がキャスターを相手にすれば指差しだけで終る。
findings.governingReading: If Shirou faced Caster, it would end with no more than her pointing a finger.
findings.explanation: The one-gesture scale of Caster’s magical superiority disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 綱渡りめいた戦いだった。
findings.governingReading: it was a battle like walking a tightrope
findings.explanation: The desperate, continuously precarious image becomes an orderly contest.
